nodes.label: Supabase DATABASE_URL session mode rationale
nodes.rationale: Session mode (port 5432) of Supavisor is required because migrate and prepared statements fail on transaction mode (6543); 6543 is only for serverless high-scale and DISABLE_SERVER_SIDE_CURSORS is forced in base.py when ENGINE is postgres.

nodes.label: Media as URLField links rationale
nodes.rationale: There is no upload: product/service/portfolio/avatar images are external URLField links (validate_image_url) because the Vercel filesystem is ephemeral/read-only, so no bucket or django-storages is used and SERVE_MEDIA=False.

nodes.label: In-memory SQLite test settings rationale
nodes.rationale: config.settings.test forces SQLite in memory so tests run offline and never touch the dev/prod database.

nodes.label: UUID PKs via BaseModel rationale
nodes.rationale: All domain models inherit BaseModel (UUID pk, timestamps, is_active), so detail/edit URLs use <uuid:pk>; public shop/services listings use <slug:slug> with random auto-generated slugs via RandomSlugMixin.
